summary: Completed backend-only testing for Wrecker Mode Quick-Add Driver + Assignment workflow. All critical requirements verified successfully.

minor_issues.issue: Pydantic validation returns 422 instead of 400 for missing required fields
minor_issues.impact: Minor - Standard Pydantic behavior, functionally correct
minor_issues.note: When 'name' field is missing entirely, Pydantic returns 422 with detailed validation error. This is acceptable and standard behavior.

passed_tests: POST /api/wrecker/drivers/quick-add - Minimal payload (name only) creates driver successfully with auto-generated email
POST /api/wrecker/drivers/quick-add - Duplicate email check works correctly (returns 409 for existing emails)
POST /api/wrecker/drivers/quick-add - Optional fields (phone, truck_number, email) are saved correctly
GET /api/wrecker/drivers - Quick-added driver appears in drivers list immediately
POST /api/wrecker/jobs - Pending job creation works correctly
POST /api/wrecker/jobs/{job_id}/assign - CRITICAL: Creates TWO status_history entries (status='assigned' + note='Assigned to <driver_name>')
GET /api/wrecker/jobs/{job_id} - Status history persists correctly with both entries
POST /api/wrecker/drivers/quick-add - Auth gate: wrecker_operator role correctly receives 403 Forbidden
End-to-end flow: quick-add → verify in list → assign → verify status change - All steps work correctly

Optional fields (phone, truck_number, email) are saved correctly
Returns temp_password in response for dispatcher to share with new driver
Auto-assigns rotation_rank at end of current rotation

Entry 2: {note: 'Assigned to <driver_name>', at: <timestamp>, by: <user_id>}
Status changes from 'pending' to 'assigned' correctly
assigned_driver_id is set correctly
Status history persists correctly on subsequent GET requests
wrecker_operator role correctly receives 403 Forbidden when attempting to quick-add a driver
Only dispatcher/supervisor/admin roles can create drivers
